title: Restrictions
description: Runtime requirements found after a version was measured, each with the reason whoever is held back is shown. An entry narrows the runtime range of the versions it covers: without `versions` only this one, with `versions` the listed earlier versions through this one.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: The module versions the entry covers, as `>=` / `>` / `<=` / `<` comparators; a range with no upper bound runs through this version. Absent, the entry covers only this version.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: What breaks outside the range, shown to whoever the entry holds back.
